name: URPD-History
description: BitcoinURPD.com — every bitcoin by the price it last moved at, daily since 2009. Scrub through history by dragging the dot or with the arrow keys, or watch the full-history videos. Coloured by short- and long-term holders or coin age. Explainer in English, Chinese and Japanese. Data from Bitcoin Research Kit.

paragraphs: The Bitcoin URPD (UTXO Realized Price Distribution) sorts every bitcoin by the price at which it last moved on-chain and adds up the supply at each price. BitcoinURPD.com draws it for every day since 2009-01-03, each bar split into short- and long-term holders (LTH/STH, at 150 days) or into 23 age bands, with the left axis fitted to each day's own bars. It is a cost-basis distribution of the whole bitcoin supply: a tall bar is a price where a lot of supply last moved, a gap is a price where almost none did, and the price box gives the share of the day's value (or coins) in profit and in loss…
